scientific_integrity: The optimum edge-general-position number for cycles, n up to five and four thereafter, is previously known and is explicitly not claimed as new. The proof supplies the new face/facet enumerators and purity classification; independent assessment has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite simple cycles C_n with n>=3 and the ordinary three-edge shortest-path prohibition. Publication priority is provisional; inaccessible complete texts and possible unindexed results remain residual risks. Computation is finite corroboration, not a proof for unbounded n.
title: The edge-general-position complex of cycles: exact face and facet polynomials
